footer.disclaimer: Independent proof of concept. Not affiliated with or endorsed by WMO or the Climpact maintainers.
about.p1: This is a small working model that explores what a modern replacement for the Climpact workflow could look like: load a station file, check its quality, calculate climate indices with the open-source xclim library, and download the results.
about.p2: It is built for slow and unstable connections. The whole page is well under 150 KB when compressed, loads nothing from other websites, repeats a request by itself when the connection drops, and tells you what it is doing while it waits.
about.p3: Index values are compared with the original R tool for the sample station. The proof of concept covers station data and a selection of indices; it is not a finished product and its results should be checked before use in a published report.
load.heading: Load data
load.lead: Load one station's daily rainfall and minimum and maximum temperature. The file is checked, then you choose which climate indices to calculate.
load.file.heading: Station file
load.file.drop: Drop a station text file here, or
load.format.summary: What the file should look like
load.format.p1: A plain text file with one line per day and six values on each line, separated by spaces, tabs or commas:
load.format.cols: year, month, day, rainfall (mm), maximum temperature (°C), minimum temperature (°C)
load.format.p2: Every day needs a line, in date order: write -99.9 where a value is missing. A header line is ignored. This is the same layout used by RClimDex and Climpact station files.
load.sample.hint: Loads 80 years of daily data (1936 to 2015) that is already on the server. Nothing is uploaded.
load.settings.heading: Station details
load.name.label: Station name
load.name.help: Used to label charts and downloaded files. If left empty, the file name is used.
load.lat.label: Latitude (degrees)
load.lon.label: Longitude (degrees)
load.lat.help: Latitude tells the tool which hemisphere the station is in, which changes how seasonal indices such as growing season length are calculated. Use negative numbers for south and for west.
load.lat.error: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90.
load.lon.error: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180.
load.base.help: The base period is the span of years that defines what is normal for this station. Percentile indices, such as warm days (TX90p), compare every day with it. Choose 30 years with good data; 1971 to 2000 is the default.
load.base.errorYears: Enter both years of the base period as whole numbers, for example 1971 and 2000.
load.base.errorOrder: The first year of the base period must be earlier than the last year.
load.upload.hint: Choose a file first, or try the sample station.
load.upload.hintReady: The file is sent to the server and checked. This usually takes a few seconds.
load.upload.hintReplace: This replaces the data that is loaded now.
load.upload.hintLoaded: Data is loaded. Change a value under "Station details" to check it again with other settings.
load.apply.hint: The station details changed. The data is sent again with the new values; you do not need to choose the file again.
load.apply.needFile: The station details changed, but the page was reloaded since the file was chosen. Choose the file again to apply them.
load.progress.label: Upload progress
load.privacy: Your data stays in memory on the server for {minutes} minutes and is never written to disk.
load.status.checking: File received. The server is reading and checking it.
load.status.slow: Still working. On a slow connection this can take a minute.
load.done: Data loaded for {name}. Quality control is shown next.
load.error.tooLarge: This file is {size}. The largest file that can be loaded is {limit}.
load.delete.busy: Deleting your data from the server.
load.delete.done: Your data has been deleted from the server.
load.delete.failed: The deletion could not be confirmed. {reason}
load.delete.auto: If nothing else is done, the server deletes the data by itself at about {time}.
load.precheck.rows.one: Quick check in your browser: {n} line of data, {first}.
load.precheck.rows.other: Quick check in your browser: {n} lines of data, from {first} to {last}.
load.precheck.problems: This file may be rejected. Found before uploading:
load.precheck.header: Line {line} looks like a header. That is fine: the server skips it.
load.precheck.columns: Line {line} has {found} values. Each line needs 6: year, month, day, rainfall, maximum temperature, minimum temperature.
load.precheck.not_number: Line {line} contains "{found}", which is not a number. Write a missing value as -99.9, not as a blank or as text.
load.precheck.bad_date: Line {line}: "{found}" is not a valid year, month and day.
load.precheck.binary: This does not look like a text file. Spreadsheet files (.xlsx) must first be saved as plain text.
load.precheck.more.one: and {n} more line with a problem
load.precheck.stillUpload: You can still upload it: the server gives the full report.
load.loaded.heading: Data loaded: {name}
load.loaded.keptUnknown: for up to {minutes} minutes after loading
qc.heading: Quality control
qc.lead: Checks on the daily data for {name}, before any index is calculated.
qc.verdict.clean.title: No problems found. The data is ready to use.
qc.verdict.clean.body: All checks passed. Look at the missing days below, then continue.
qc.verdict.warnings.title: Usable, with warnings to review.
qc.verdict.warnings.body: Some values look unusual but may be real, such as a record rainfall. Open the checks below to review them. You can continue now.
qc.verdict.errors.title: Errors found. Results may be unreliable.
qc.verdict.errors.body: Some values cannot be right, for example a maximum temperature below the minimum. It is best to correct the file and load it again. You can also continue, knowing that these days affect the indices.
qc.strip.heading: Missing days in each year
qc.strip.help: One column per year, one row per variable. Darker cells have more missing days; taller cells are years over the limit used for annual indices.
qc.strip.table: Show the years with missing days as a table
qc.strip.none: The server did not report missing days by year.
qc.strip.rowLabel: {variable}: {years} years have missing days, {over} of them over the limit.
qc.strip.legend.2: More than {limit} days missing: no annual value
qc.strip.tableNote: * More than {limit} missing days: annual indices are not calculated for that year (default rule).
qc.checks.heading: Checks
qc.checks.help: Open a check to see the records it flagged. Nothing is removed or changed: flagged values are still used unless you correct the file and load it again.
qc.checks.none: The server did not report any checks.
qc.rerun: To check again with a different base period or location, go back to step 1, change the values and choose "Apply changes". The file does not need to be chosen again.
qc.check.passed: No records were flagged. If any were found, this check would count as: {severity}.
qc.check.capped: Showing the first {shown} of {total} records. The download contains all of them.
qc.daily.heading: Daily values
qc.daily.help: Plot every day of the record for one variable, with flagged values marked. The daily data is only downloaded when you ask for it.
qc.daily.slow: Still downloading. A long record can take a minute on a slow connection.
qc.daily.keys: Drag across the chart to zoom into a period; double-click to return to the whole record. With the keyboard: focus the chart and use the left and right arrow keys to read values, and the buttons above to zoom.
qc.daily.decimated: At this zoom each position shows the lowest and highest day; zoom in to see every day.
indices.heading: Choose indices
indices.lead: Tick the climate indices to calculate. Each one turns the daily record into one value per year or per month.
indices.validatedNote: {n} of {total} indices carry the badge "Checked against R": their values for the sample station were compared with the output of the original R tool.
indices.validatedNone: None of these indices has yet been marked as compared with the original R tool.
indices.reason.inputs: Cannot be calculated: this file has no {variables}.
indices.reason.frequency.monthly: Only available as one value per year.
indices.reason.frequency.annual: Only available as one value per month.
indices.none: Tick at least one index first.
indices.listFailed: The list of indices could not be loaded. {reason}
indices.status.slow: Still calculating. A long record with many indices can take up to a minute. You can leave this page open; the request is repeated automatically if the connection drops.
indices.done.one: {n} index calculated. Results are shown next.
indices.done.other: {n} indices calculated. Results are shown next.
results.heading: Results
results.none: No index could be calculated. Go back and choose other indices.
results.download.heading: Download results
results.download.help: All calculated indices in one file. The ZIP opens in any spreadsheet program; it also contains the quality control findings and a description of the columns and settings.
results.download.preparing: Preparing the file on the server and downloading it.
results.download.slow: Still downloading. Nothing is lost if the connection drops: the request is repeated.
results.settings.heading: Settings used
results.settings.help: Quote these with the results so that someone else can reproduce them.
results.settings.policyText: "{id}": a year is left empty if it has more than {year} missing days or if any of its months is empty; a month is left empty if it has more than {month} missing days.
results.settings.trendText: Sen's slope with a 95% range; Mann-Kendall test for the p-value; calculated when there are at least 10 values and at least 70% of the period has a value.
results.compare.heading: Compare two indices
results.compare.needTwo: Calculate at least two indices to compare them.
results.compare.same: Choose two different indices to compare them.
results.compare.shared: Both indices are in {unit}, so they share one scale.
results.compare.separate: These indices have different units, so each has its own panel above a shared time axis. Two scales on one panel would suggest a link that the data does not show.
results.cards.heading: Each index
results.chartLabel: Chart of {name}. Use the left and right arrow keys to read values.
results.pngAria: Download the {name} chart as PNG image
results.svgAria: Download the {name} chart as SVG image
results.pngFailed: The image could not be made in this browser. Try SVG instead.
trend.flat: No change: the trend is 0 {unit} per decade.
trend.untestable: Trend of {slope} {unit} per decade. It could not be tested, usually because the values hardly vary.
trend.range: The 95% range is {lower} to {upper} per decade.
trend.significant: This trend is statistically significant ({p}): it is unlikely to be due to chance alone.
trend.notSignificant: This trend is not statistically significant ({p}): a change this small can appear by chance in a record with no real trend.
trend.method: Sen's slope and Mann-Kendall test on {n} values.
chart.hint: Move over the chart, or focus it and press the arrow keys, to read values.
load.precheck.gap: Line {line}: {found} day(s) are left out before this date. Every day needs a line; write -99.9 where there is no observation.
load.precheck.order: Line {line}: the date {found} is earlier than the line before it. Lines must be in date order.
load.precheck.duplicate: Line {line}: the date {found} appears more than once.
qc.tile.flaggedSub.one: flagged record, in {checks} of the checks.
qc.tile.flaggedSub.other: flagged records, in {checks} of the checks.
qc.notes.heading: Noted while reading the file:
qc.thresholds.summary: Change the thresholds and run the checks again
qc.thresholds.help: The checks compare each day with these limits. Change a limit if it does not suit your climate, for example a higher rainfall limit for a cyclone-prone station. The data is not sent again.
qc.thresholds.busy: Running the checks again with the new limits.
qc.thresholds.done: Checks run again with the new limits. The summary above is updated.
qc.setting.tmax_tmin_inclusive: Also flag days where the maximum equals the minimum
qc.setting.max_abs_temperature: Highest plausible temperature, above or below zero (°C)
qc.setting.iqr_factor_temperature: Temperature outliers: distance beyond the usual range, in multiples of the interquartile range
qc.setting.iqr_factor_precip: Rainfall outliers: distance beyond the usual range, in multiples of the interquartile range
qc.setting.climatology_sd: Temperature outliers: standard deviations from the usual value for the time of year
qc.setting.climatology_window_days: Days on either side that count as the same time of year
qc.setting.max_temperature_jump: Largest plausible change from one day to the next (°C)
qc.setting.flatline_min_repeats: Flag a value repeated on at least this many following days
qc.setting.rounding_digit_share: Rounding: share of a year's values ending in the same digit (0 to 1)
qc.setting.rounding_min_values: Rounding: fewest values in a year for the check to apply
qc.setting.max_missing_days_per_month: Missing days allowed in a month
qc.setting.max_missing_days_per_year: Missing days allowed in a year
indices.differsNote.one: {n} index gives values that differ from the R tool and is marked "Differs from R"; the validation report explains why.
indices.differsNote.other: {n} indices give values that differ from the R tool and are marked "Differs from R"; the validation report explains why.
trend.none: No trend was calculated: too few values. A trend needs at least 10 values and values for at least 70% of the period.
qc.daily.flagsCapped: Only the first {n} records of each check are marked.
results.flat.zeroDays: 0 in every {period} of the record: no such days were recorded at this station. There is nothing to chart.
results.flat.zero: 0 in every {period} of the record at this station. There is nothing to chart.
results.flat.missing: No value could be calculated for any {period}: too much of the data it needs is missing.
notice.apiIgnored: The "api" value in the address was ignored: it is not one of the servers this site is set up to use.
conn.demoUnreachable: Calculation server not reachable: showing the demonstration
demo.unreachable: The calculation server is not reachable right now. You are seeing the demonstration with saved results for the sample station; uploading your own file is unavailable until it is back.
demo.only: This is the public demonstration. It has no calculation server: you are seeing saved results for the sample station, and uploading your own file is not available here.
demo.back: The calculation server is reachable again. You are still seeing the demonstration until you switch.
demo.stillDown: Still not reachable (checked at {time}). It is checked again every minute.
demo.left: The calculation server is reachable. You are now using it; the demonstration data has been put away.
demo.uploadOff: Uploading a file is switched off in the demonstration: there is no calculation server to send it to. Use "Try the sample station" to see how the tool works.
demo.uploadOffUnreachable: Uploading a file is unavailable until the calculation server is back. Use "Try the sample station" to see the demonstration meanwhile.
demo.settingsOff: These values cannot be changed in the demonstration: the saved example was made with the values shown.
demo.sampleHint: Shows the saved example: 80 years of daily data (1936 to 2015) for the sample station. Nothing is uploaded or calculated.
demo.source: Saved example of the sample station (nothing was uploaded)
demo.thresholds: Demonstration: this is one saved example of a re-run. It shows what a re-run looks like; it does not use the limits you entered.
demo.results: These are saved example results for the sample station. Nothing was calculated just now.
demo.downloads: ZIP and NetCDF files are made by the calculation server, so they are switched off in the demonstration. JSON and the CSV, PNG and SVG buttons on each index work.
